connection.notes: Needs a PCIe/SATA power cable, a USB cable to a motherboard 9-pin USB header and optionally a 5 V ARGB + 4-pin PWM cable for motherboard sync. Up to 3 TL LCD fans per cable/port; max. 7 TL LCD fans per controller (16 TL + TL LCD in total); 8 to 12 TL LCD fans need two controllers. TL LCD fans only work on ports 2, 3 and 4.

notes: The physical size and the exact port count and positions of the 2nd generation controller are NOT published in the sources found: 80 x 50 x 16 mm is a placeholder (approximate). USB IDs are those used by the LED tool. Please measure and replace.
